description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hanchapola, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510202 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner information, and title classifications. The content is focused entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
